status_semantics.SPECIFIED: Versioned design and contracts exist; no implementation claim.
status_semantics.IMPLEMENTED: Code exists and static/interface checks pass; no test-completeness claim.
status_semantics.TESTED: Required automated test classes pass for the bound source commit; does not imply independent verification.
status_semantics.INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED: Qualified reviewer has independently assessed the exact implementation and evidence digest.
status_semantics.PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED: Authorized human activation approval exists, deployment identity and configuration are verified, and rollback procedure is tested.

implementation_lifecycle.non_equivalence_rule: Statuses are distinct milestones and MUST NOT be inferred from one another; promotion requires separate evidence.
implementation_lifecycle.policy: Do not claim a status without its own evidence. Missing, stale, malformed, contradictory, unauthenticated, or wrong-commit evidence BLOCKS promotion. Status transitions require milestone-specific authenticated evidence. Any source, policy, workflow, configuration, or artifact change invalidates the evidence whose declared dependency set includes that changed input; unrelated evidence may remain valid only when its dependency binding proves non-impact.

sequence.pass_rule: Administrator-authenticated configuration is read back from an authorized source; inaccessible endpoints or empty results without sufficient visibility do not pass.
A qualified independent human reviewer is explicitly assigned by an authorized administrator and bound to the candidate commit and evidence digest.
Every finding is closed with traceable remediation and independent retest evidence; unresolved or stale findings block.
Stacked PRs advance only in dependency order; complete CI passes on the exact current head after every rebase or retarget.
Affirmative human acceptance is authenticated and bound to the same final commit and evidence digest after independent review and findings closure.
Verified protection rules and required checks enforce all applicable review, CI, and acceptance gates before each protected merge.
Live OIDC claims and signed provenance verify against the merged SHA and artifact digest; independent retention and retrieval are evidenced.
Complete authenticated evidence packet is delivered unchanged to RX-19 for the sole release decision.

invalidation_rules: any source commit, tree, PR base/head, workflow run/attempt, policy version, artifact digest, evidence digest, reviewer identity, acceptance record, protection configuration, or retention policy change invalidates dependent evidence and requires revalidation

research_quality_rules: Prefer primary government, standards-body, official project and original research sources; use secondary commentary only for context.
Record source title, publisher, canonical URL, publication/revision date, access date, jurisdiction, source type and exact claim supported.
Separate binding law/regulation, government policy, standards, normative specifications, voluntary guidance, vendor documentation and opinion.
Cross-check consequential claims against independent sources when feasible; record disagreement and missing evidence.
Never claim compliance, security, safety, certification or production readiness from a mapping exercise alone.
Research agents do not execute production changes, approve policy, assign reviewers, accept releases or override RX-19.
research_intelligence_contract.mandatory_review: Material recommendations require accountable domain-owner review; high-risk security conclusions require independent human review.
invalidation_rules: source superseded or withdrawn
material framework/version change
jurisdiction or system scope changes

architecture_principles: Contract-first, versioned interfaces; typed inputs/outputs; deterministic validation; explicit error and timeout semantics.
Separate planner, policy decision, executor, verifier, and human authority; no agent may grant itself capabilities.

Durable state machine with idempotency keys, bounded retries, checkpoints, cancellation, compensation, and tested recovery.
Model/provider routing is policy-constrained and quality-aware; data residency, privacy, cost, and capability restrictions override convenience.
Treat retrieved content, tool output, documents, and external prompts as untrusted data; prevent instruction/data boundary collapse.
Consequential outputs carry source lineage, version, uncertainty, evaluation evidence, and an explicit distinction between recommendation and completed action.

Observability correlates agent, workflow, and tool spans while minimizing sensitive input/output capture.
Human approval is required for consequential, irreversible, external, legal, financial, identity, production, or release actions.
No self-approval, fabricated evidence, hidden side effects, uncontrolled recursion, unbounded consumption, or silent fail-open fallback.
All new agents remain disabled and specification-only until implemented, tested, independently reviewed, and explicitly authorized.
